principle_violations.reason: The `Order` class handles both order data management and item manipulation, violating the principle by assuming multiple responsibilities.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the item management into a dedicated class, such as `OrderItemManager`, and use it within the `Order` class.

principle_violations.reason: Adding a new payment method requires modifying the application by creating a new `PaymentProcessor` implementation.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce an abstract class or interface to handle common payment processor functionalities and make the `PaymentProcessor` implementations configurable dynamically.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
